description: This file defines a Java interface used as a mapper for PaymentType entities and their corresponding data transfer objects (DTOs). It uses Mapstruct for object mapping configuration.

classes.name: PaymentTypeMapper
classes.description: A Mapstruct mapper interface for converting PaymentType domain objects to PaymentTypeData DTOs and vice versa.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a PaymentType entity to its DTO form.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a list of PaymentType entities to a list of PaymentTypeData DTOs.
